title: Petrichor: the smell of first rain isn't the soil
planner: Claude Opus 5.5 (Fable at its limit), 27 Oct 2026

facts.claim: The smell of rain on dry earth was named 'petrichor' in 1964 by Australian scientists Isabel Bear and Richard Thomas
A key molecule in the smell is geosmin, produced by soil bacteria such as Streptomyces
Raindrops hitting soil release tiny aerosols that carry the scent into the air
Humans can smell geosmin at extremely low concentrations (parts per trillion)
facts.source: Royal Society of Chemistry; scientific reviews

opening.why: Story/object hook; location isn't the surprise.

hook_en: You love the smell of first rain. Soil doesn't make it. Bacteria do.

headline: THE SMELL
OF FIRST RAIN
cover.hook_voiceover_ml: പുതുമഴ. നനഞ്ഞ മണ്ണ്. ആ മണം. പക്ഷേ ആ മണം ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നത് മണ്ണല്ല. ബാക്ടീരിയയാണ്!
cover.visual: A Kerala courtyard at dusk; first big drops hit the red earth and scent wisps rise
cover.build_cmd: SK.sky(g,'dusk',0.55) with dark clouds (grey ellipses drifting). Red laterite courtyard ground from y0.6 (#9a4a2a→#6a2e1a), a SK.house at x0.75 with lit windows, SK.palm at x0.15. Big raindrops (white elongated drops) fall one by one; each impact makes a dark wet spot and a small splash; from each spot a green-tinted scent wisp (thin wavy translucent line) rises. Rate of drops increases over the scene.

scenes.voiceover_ml: ഈ മണത്തിന് ഒരു പേരുണ്ട്. പെട്രിക്കോർ. 1964-ൽ ശാസ്ത്രജ്ഞർ ഇട്ട പേര്.
scenes.headline: IT HAS A NAME
scenes.visual: An old journal page with the word appearing letter by letter
scenes.build_cmd: Cream journal page (x0.5,y0.45) with faint printed lines; a quill draws a long underline at 30%; rain streaks on a window frame behind. A green glow pulses at 70%. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: മണ്ണിലെ കുഞ്ഞൻ ബാക്ടീരിയകൾ ജിയോസ്മിൻ എന്നൊരു രാസവസ്തു ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു.
scenes.headline: BACTERIA MAKE IT
scenes.visual: A microscope view of soil: filament-like bacteria release glowing molecules
scenes.build_cmd: Microscope circle (radius 380, x0.5,y0.45) with brown soil grains; 8 branching filament chains (green lines with beads) grow outwards 0–60%; from their tips small glowing hexagon molecules pop out and drift 50–100%. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: മഴത്തുള്ളി മണ്ണിൽ വീഴുമ്പോൾ, ആ മണം കുഞ്ഞു കുമിളകളായി വായുവിലേക്ക് ഉയരുന്നു.
scenes.headline: RAINDROPS LAUNCH IT
scenes.visual: Slow-motion raindrop hits soil; tiny bubbles burst and fling aerosols upward
scenes.build_cmd: Huge slow-motion drop falls to a soil surface at y0.6 (0–35%), flattens on impact; 20 tiny bubbles rise inside it and burst at the top (45–80%), each burst flinging 3 glowing dots upward. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: നമ്മുടെ മൂക്കിന് ഇത് തീരെ ചെറിയ അളവിൽ പോലും തിരിച്ചറിയാൻ കഴിയും.
scenes.headline: YOUR NOSE IS A DETECTOR
scenes.visual: A face in profile breathing in glowing scent particles; a meter needle jumps
scenes.build_cmd: Large face profile silhouette (left, x0.3) facing right; stream of tiny glowing dots flows into the nose 20–70%; a round gauge (right, x0.72) with a needle that swings from 0 to max at 60%. Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

scenes.voiceover_ml: അടുത്ത പുതുമഴയിൽ ആ മണം വരുമ്പോൾ ഓർക്കുക: അത് മണ്ണിനുള്ളിലെ ജീവന്റെ മണമാണ്.
scenes.headline: THE SMELL OF LIFE
scenes.visual: A child at a window watching the rain, green wisps drifting in
scenes.build_cmd: Window frame (wood) with rain outside; SK.person child silhouette at the sill (x0.5), green scent wisps drift in through the window; warm lamp light inside (SK.lamp at x0.8). Keep the top 20% and bottom 25% clear; finish every frame with SK.grain(g, t).

instagram_caption:
പുതുമഴയുടെ ആ മണം മണ്ണിന്റേതല്ല! 🌧️
That smell of the first rain doesn't come from the soil!

അതിന് ഒരു പേരുണ്ട്: പെട്രിക്കോർ. മണ്ണിലെ ബാക്ടീരിയകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്ന ജിയോസ്മിൻ ആണ് ആ മണത്തിന് പിന്നിൽ.
It's called petrichor, and the scent comes from geosmin, made by soil bacteria.

പുതുമഴ പെയ്യുമ്പോൾ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ഓർമ്മ വരുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
What do you remember when the first rain falls?
